title: A Unified Framework for Training-Dataset Aggregation and Exact Machine Unlearning via Gibbs Probability Measures
abstract: arXiv:2611.05544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, three operations on Gibbs probability measures are studied: renormalization, normalized log-linear combination, and nesting. The resulting measures are shown to be Gibbs probability measures with explicit expressions for their objective functions, reference measures, and regularization factors. These measures are further characterized as unique solutions to optimization problems involving linear combinations of the original objective functions, subject to either relative entropy regularization or relative entropy constraints. When the reference measures are probability measures, geometric interpretations of these three operations are established involving Pythagorean identities and exponential geodesics.A central result is the equivalence between nesting and normalized log-linear combinations of Gibbs probability measures. translated_title: 基于Gibbs概率测度的训练数据集聚合与精确机器遗忘统一框架
translated_abstract: 本文研究了Gibbs概率测度上的三种操作：重归一化、归一化对数线性组合以及嵌套。结果表明，所得测度仍是Gibbs概率测度，且其目标函数、参考测度和正则化因子均具有显式表达式。进一步地，这些测度被刻画为涉及原始目标函数线性组合的优化问题的唯一解，其中优化问题受相对熵正则化或相对熵约束的限制。当参考测度为概率测度时，这三种操作获得了涉及毕达哥拉斯恒等式与指数测地线的几何解释。本文的一个核心结果是证明了Gibbs概率测度的嵌套与归一化对数线性组合之间的等价性。随后，这些结果被应用于采用Gibbs算法的有监督机器学习，即训练数据集聚合与精确机器遗忘（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了Gibbs概率测度上重归一化、归一化对数线性组合与嵌套三种操作的统一理论框架，证明了嵌套与归一化对数线性组合的等价性，并据此实现了有监督机器学习中的训练数据集聚合与精确机器遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified framework of three operations (renormalization, normalized log-linear combination, and nesting) on Gibbs probability measures, proves the equivalence between nesting and normalized log-linear combinations, and applies these results to training-dataset aggregation and exact machine unlearning in supervised Gibbs algorithms.
